messages: amma had severe stomach pain since morning. we took her to Yashoda hospital in Hyderabad
Oh no. Is she okay now? Did the doctors see her?
yes Dr. Lakshmi checked. scan shows gallstones, they are saying surgery
That sounds scary but gallbladder surgery is very common and usually goes well. When is it?
tomorrow morning 8am. she is admitted already
Are you at the hospital with her?
yes with appa. my Padma aunty is coming to stay the night
Good that family is around. Have you eaten anything?
only chai. canteen food here is bad
Please try to eat something proper, even a sandwich. You need strength too.
surgery is done. she is in the recovery room
Thank God. Did the doctor say how it went?
Dr. Lakshmi said all good, laparoscopic so small cuts. she will stay 2 days
That's great news. Small cuts mean quicker recovery.
yes. i finally ate, appa bought idli from outside
Good. How's your appa holding up?
he is quiet, keeps checking on her. but relieved
He's just worried. A quiet cup of tea together might help.
yes will do. Padma aunty is bringing home food tonight
Home food will lift everyone's mood.
amma came home today! doctor discharged her
Wonderful! How is she feeling at home?
a little weak, sleeping a lot. i made her rasam and rice
Rasam rice is perfect for a weak stomach. Did she like it?
she said too much pepper lol, so she is back to normal
Complaining about pepper is a very good sign!
haha true. also i have to submit my project at college on friday
Busy week. Can your cousin help with home so you can work?
yes Padma aunty is staying 3 more days
That should help you a lot.
we went for the follow up check today. Dr. Lakshmi said healing is perfect
That's lovely to hear. Any food rules for her?
no fried or oily food for a month. she is sad because she loves bonda
A month isn't forever. Maybe baked or steamed versions, so she doesn't feel left out.
good idea, will try air fryer. we got one from my cousin in Diwali last year
also asked her to walk 15 min daily in the evening
Gentle walks are great for recovery.
hey. long day, project presentation done finally
Congrats Sneha! How did it go?
sir liked it. he asked two tough questions though
Tough questions mean he took it seriously.
ok. also amma is walking to the temple now by herself. feeling relieved
That's a big step. You must be so relieved.
yes. watching Ponniyin Selvan again tonight, can't stop
heyy aira, it's getting cold in Hyderabad finally
Nice, cold weather and chai. Anything planned this week?
nothing, just exams approaching in 2 weeks
Do you want a study timetable?
later maybe. got a haircut today, cut too short lol
It'll grow back. Was the barber a stranger?
new salon near my college. never again
Lesson learned. Stick to your usual one.

probes.expect: Knows mom had gallbladder surgery in early October and has recovered at home, walking again

probes.ask: which hospital was she admitted to?
what was the surgeon's name again?
what did the doctor say she should avoid eating?
probes.expect: Says fried or oily food for a month

probes.ask: who stayed with us at the hospital that night?
what does my dad do for work again?
probes.expect: Says it doesn't know / wasn't told; invents no job

search.query: where did they admit her when the pain started?
what is the sweet thing she is not allowed to snack on
